svg.title: ベクトル場をつくる3つの方法
svg.desc: 3枚の図で、アプリの勾配、回転、勾配の外積による3次元ベクトル場を比較します。シード 42、周波数 0.65、y=0.37 の断面を使い、各図で x,z ∈ [−2,2] を11×11の格子に分け、セルの中心を標本化します。矢印の横成分と縦成分は vx と vz に比例し、共通の線形尺度を使います。個々のベクトルの正規化やクリッピングは行いません。色は vy を含む3次元ベクトル全体の大きさを示します。断面に投影した成分であり、完全な2次元ベクトル場ではないため、2次元の発散がゼロであることは示していません。勾配の中心差分は h=0.005、回転の中心差分は h=0.008 です。
svg.metadata: {"file":"vector-fields.svg","title":"Three ways to build a vector field","caption":"Three panels sample the app’s Gradient, Curl, and Gradient cross 3D vector fields on y=0.37 at seed 42 and frequency 0.65. Each panel contains an 11×11 center-sampled grid over x,z in [−2,2]. Arrow horizontal and vertical components are proportional to vx and vz using one shared linear scale, without normalizing or clipping individual vectors. Color shows the full 3D vector magnitude, including vy. These are projected components on a slice, not complete two-dimensional fields, and the figure makes no 2D divergence claim. Gradient uses centered differences h=0.005; curl uses h=0.008.","seed":42,"frequency":0.65,"slice":{"y":0.37},"time":0,"domain":{"x":[-2,2],"z":[-2,2]},"sampling":{"resolution":11,"location":"cell centers"},"arrowComponents":["vx","vz"],"arrowPixelsPerVectorUnit":16.945831699471604,"maximumArrowLength":22,"individualVectorNormalization":false,"colorQuantity":"sqrt(vx^2+vy^2+vz^2)","colorRange":[0,1.5],"gradientDifferenceStep":0.005,"curlDifferenceStep":0.008,"stats":{"gradient":{"maximumMagnitude":1.0623766527610992,"maximumProjectedMagnitude":0.8765147571043729},"curl":{"maximumMagnitude":1.4982454458160877,"maximumProjectedMagnitude":1.298254366629051},"cross":{"maximumMagnitude":0.7466057507546695,"maximumProjectedMagnitude":0.737654473949918}},"potentials":{"a":"noise_42(f*x+2.1,f*y+8.3,f*z+4.7)","b":"noise_1055(f*x+5.1,f*y+1.3,f*z+9.7)","c":"noise_2071(f*x+7.1,f*y+3.3,f*z+1.7)"},"formula":{"gradient":"grad(a)","curl":"curl([a,b,c])","cross":"cross(grad(a),grad(b))"},"caveat":"The omitted y component and y derivatives matter. This projection does not establish 2D divergence freedom. No advection, cache interpolation, constant-speed transform, or surface projection is shown.","sourceHashes":{"noise.js":"ff0b3055833606d05669bf2cea519ece6cba13f30812aca562a1c7876034416b","animation.js":"e23f707809c1c060f4cd1bed24f87e9c3ad3c2c000bbfad334921eebf82ab66e","lessons.js":"68557c48f138c9f18ff18949717f0374e82b5b70b6319edd45aaab4707bb44a9"}}

g.text: ベクトル場をつくる3つの方法
色：3次元ベクトルの大きさ |v|
矢印の長さ：場の 1 単位
矢印は (vx, vz) を共通の線形尺度で表示。y 成分は省略しています
この xz 断面から、2次元の発散がゼロであるとは言えません
